title: Exact linear descent of coefficient equivalences and mixed pullback comparisons
statement:
Fix a finite-field datum $(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, and an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$. Let $T$ be a noetherian finite-dimensional scheme with $\ell$ invertible, in the sense of [lem-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-characterization]; such schemes are called allowed. For each finite $E\subset\Omega$ over $\mathbf Q_\ell$, use the framework integral category and raw rationalization $\mathcal C_E^s(T)$ of [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] and the PBC integral category and raw rationalization $\mathcal C_E^p(T)$ of [def-weil-pbc-rational-category].
For each allowed scheme $W$, suppose given exact $E$-linear equivalences $J_{W,E}:\mathcal C_E^s(W)\simeq\mathcal C_E^p(W)$ and exact natural scalar comparisons $j_{W,L/E}:J_{W,L}S_{L/E}\simeq P_{L/E}J_{W,E}$. Here $S,P$ and their associators $a^s,a^p$ are the actual transitions of [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi, lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition, prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension]. Assume the identity normalization, compatibility with shifts and the scalar cocycle
$$a^p_{M,L,E}\circ P_{M/L}(j_{W,L/E})\circ j_{W,M/L,S_{L/E}K}=j_{W,M/E}\circ J_{W,M}(a^s_{M,L,E}).$$
On the literal pair categories $\mathcal C_W$ [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients] and $\mathcal P_W$ [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category], the formulas
$$J_W(E,K)=(E,J_{W,E}K),\qquad J_W[L,u]=[L,j_{W,L/F,H}\circ J_{W,L}(u)\circ j_{W,L/E,K}^{-1}]$$
for $u:S_{L/E}K\to S_{L/F}H$ define exact $\Omega$-linear equivalences. At every common stage this conjugation is a Hom bijection commuting with further scalar transport, and it and its inverse descend to inverse Hom-colimit maps. The functors preserve finite-stage inclusions, shifts and common-stage distinguished triangles in both directions, with no Karoubi completion.
Suppose additionally that for each allowed scheme isomorphism $h:U\simeq T$ there are natural finite rational comparisons $b_{h,E}:J_{U,E}F^s_{h,E}\simeq F^p_{h,E}J_{T,E}$ of the actual pullbacks [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Assume their mixed scalar square, namely
$$F^p_{h,L}(j_T)\circ b_{h,L,S_TK}\circ J_{U,L}(\alpha^s_K)=\alpha^p_{J_{T,E}K}\circ P_U(b_{h,E,K})\circ j_{U,F^s_{h,E}K},$$
where $\alpha^s:S_UF^s_{h,E}\to F^s_{h,L}S_T$ and $\alpha^p:P_UF^p_{h,E}\to F^p_{h,L}P_T$ are the specified rational scalar/pullback comparisons. Then the finite-stage classes of $b_{h,E,K}$ define natural isomorphisms $b_h:J_UF_h^s\simeq F_h^pJ_T$ for the actual common-stage pullbacks. Any identity, composition, shift and scalar equations satisfied by the finite $b$ hold for these descended comparisons. When the finite equivalences and comparisons have the normalized integral lifts, these constructions supply precisely the common-stage fields of [def-fd-coefficient-comparison-datum, def-fd-pullback-comparison-datum].

proof.text: Fix $W$. Apply [lem-fd-hom-linear-equivalence] to the given finite equivalences and scalar cocycle. It gives the specified field-preserving conjugation functor, transport-compatible stagewise Hom bijections and their inverse maps on Hom colimits, essential surjectivity and an $\Omega$-linear quasi-inverse. The construction is on literal pairs and agrees with every finite-stage inclusion.

proof.text: The resulting functor has bijective Hom maps, so [lem-fd-shift-triangle-reflection] applies with the specified finite shift comparisons. Its descended comparisons restrict to those at each finite stage. It preserves and reflects distinguished triangles, and gives reverse exactness with the induced inverse shift comparison. Thus the equivalence has all the coefficient and triangle properties asserted.

proof.text: For each $h$, apply [lem-fd-mixed-pullback-transformation] to the given mixed square. Its composite families descend to the actual $J_UF_h^s$ and $F_h^pJ_T$; it supplies the natural isomorphism with components $[E,b_{h,E,K}]$, including arbitrary unequal endpoint fields, its inverse and the descent of every assumed identity, composition, shift and scalar equation.

proof.text: Under the stipulated normalized integral lifts, [def-fd-coefficient-comparison-datum] has its integral and finite rational fields already supplied; steps 1–2 fill its literal-pair equivalence, linearity and exact shift fields. Likewise the integral realization and finite pullback fields of [def-fd-pullback-comparison-datum] are supplied by the hypothesis, and step 3 fills its compatible common-stage transformation and prescribed finite components. These are exactly the remaining fields; no integral lift or new finite coherence equation is asserted.

lean.statement: theorem fdCommonStageComparisonDescent (_D : FiniteFieldDatum.{d}) (_hl : l ≠ _D.p) (J : StageSystem.Morphism (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.stageSystem l Ω T) (pbcScalarSystem l Ω T dT.out iT.out)) [∀ E, (J.Φ E).CommShift ℤ] (hadd : ∀ E, (J.Φ E).Additive) (hequiv : ∀ E, (J.Φ E).IsEquivalence) (hlinear : ∀ E, (J.Φ E).Linear E.val) (hexact : ∀ E, (J.Φ E).IsTriangulated) (hshift : ∀ {E L : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω} (h : E ≤ L), NatTrans.CommShift (J.β h).hom ℤ) : ∃ e : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω T ≌ pbcQbarCategory l Ω T, e.functor = J.functor ∧ e.functor.Additive ∧ e.functor.Linear Ω ∧ e.inverse.Additive ∧ e.inverse.Linear Ω ∧ ∃ (s : e.functor.CommShift ℤ) (r : e.inverse.CommShift ℤ), (fun [hs : e.functor.CommShift ℤ] [hr : e.inverse.CommShift ℤ] ↦ e.functor.IsTriangulated ∧ e.inverse.IsTriangulated ∧ (∀ E (n : ℤ) (K : GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Stage l Ω T E), HEq ((e.functor.commShiftIso n).hom.app ⟨E, K⟩) (((pbcScalarSystem l Ω T dT.out iT.out).ι E).map (((J.Φ E).commShiftIso n).hom.app K) ≫ (((pbcScalarSystem l Ω T dT.out iT.out).ι E).commShiftIso n).hom.app ((J.Φ E).obj K))) ∧ (∀ A : Triangle (generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω T), e.functor.mapTriangle.obj A ∈ distTriang (pbcQbarCategory l Ω T) ↔ A ∈ distTriang (generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω T))) (hs := s) (hr := r)
